definitions.rationale: This total-function equation defines rightTriangle(A, B, C) by unfolding it to positivity checks and the three possible Pythagorean equalities; it is the mathematical summary used by the specification, not an additional fact about that summary.
definitions.text:
rule rightTriangle(A, B, C)
       => (A >Int 0)
          andBool (B >Int 0)
          andBool (C >Int 0)
          andBool (((A *Int A) +Int (B *Int B)) ==Int (C *Int C)
                   orBool ((A *Int A) +Int (C *Int C)) ==Int (B *Int B)
                   orBool ((B *Int B) +Int (C *Int C)) ==Int (A *Int A))

definitions.rationale: This nullary-function equation expands the named solutionProgram proof term to the exact translated Module AST, so it is a structural definition rather than an execution rule or mathematical lemma.
definitions.text:
rule solutionProgram
       => Module(
            FuncDef("right_angle_triangle", Params("a", "b", "c"),
              Return(
                BoolOp(
                  "and",
                  Compare(Name("a"), CmpOp(">", Int(0))),
                  Compare(Name("b"), CmpOp(">", Int(0))),
                  Compare(Name("c"), CmpOp(">", Int(0))),
                  BoolOp(
                    "or",
                    Compare(
                      BinOp(
                        "+",
                        BinOp("*", Name("a"), Name("a")),
                        BinOp("*", Name("b"), Name("b"))),
                      CmpOp("==", BinOp("*", Name("c"), Name("c")))),
                    Compare(
                      BinOp(
                        "+",
                        BinOp("*", Name("a"), Name("a")),
                        BinOp("*", Name("c"), Name("c"))),
                      CmpOp("==", BinOp("*", Name("b"), Name("b")))),
                    Compare(
                      BinOp(
                        "+",
                        BinOp("*", Name("b"), Name("b")),
                        BinOp("*", Name("c"), Name("c"))),
                      CmpOp("==", BinOp("*", Name("a"), Name("a")))))))))
